html:
What is the term for an overall territory of a group of people/nations/countries that shares ties under a political system or sphere of influence?

Like I noticed that the United States (and Mexico at one point in the past) in this timeline becoming increasingly expansionist in outer space (and also colonizing or protectorating other planets/species), but at the same time there are nations that are not directly or indirectly controlled by the United States but are interconnected? It is kind of hard to describe really. I wanted to describe a specific "inter-global" shared group, culture, or population of a certain region of space rather than describing it on the whole with the galactic bubble.

Like what would be the term for this type of shared culture/political sphere regarding interstellar space? the -Sphere? Bubble?

(Ex: Terransphere/Terran Bubble to describe the current human dominated system and not just Americans)

(Ex2:  Volorumsphere/Volorum Bubble to describe inhabitants and co. from Volorum colonizing several planets their system.)
